rules.title: Security rules
rules.description: Switch the security rules R01–R19 on and off and change their thresholds and actions. The thresholds are starting values; adjust them to your network.
rules.caption: Security rules
rules.loadFailed: The rules could not be read.
rules.empty: This version has no security rules.
rules.readOnly: You can view the rules; changing them needs the settings management permission.
rules.locked: Security rules are not enabled in your licence: you can see the rules but not change them. The rules do not run; the 5651 Temel alerts (R15, R20) keep working.

dataStatus.no_data: No data in the last 24 hours

rules.verifyHint: The log format this rule reads is not confirmed by a sample line. Compare its first alerts with the device's own records.
rules.setupHint: The rule does not run until its required parameter is set.
rules.personLevelHint: The alert is matched to the person of the address at that moment; the name is shown only to those allowed to see personal data, and every view is written to the audit log.
rules.skipped: Data that piled up before {{time}} was skipped (older than 24 hours).

sheet.title: {{id}} · {{name}}

kind.event: Event rule: one alert per key; a person closes it.
kind.condition: Condition rule: the alert closes itself when the condition is gone.

sheet.enabledHint: Once switched on it looks only at data that arrives afterwards; it raises no alerts for older data.
sheet.windowHint: Events are counted within this time: {{duration}}. Between 60 seconds and 7 days.
sheet.cooldownHint: After an alert is closed, no new alert opens for the same key within this time: {{duration}}. At most 7 days.
sheet.startingValue: Starting value; adjust it to your network.
sheet.networksHint: One IP address or network per line (CIDR, e.g. 172.20.0.0/16).
sheet.unknownParam: This parameter cannot be changed in the browser; its value: {{value}}
sheet.emailHint: Sent when the severity reaches the alert e-mail threshold of the application settings.
sheet.webhookHint: Sent to the webhooks configured on the server.
sheet.dryRunHint: Runs with these settings on the data of the last 24 hours; saves nothing and opens no alert.
sheet.dryRunResult_one: With these settings {{n}} alert would have opened in the last 24 hours
sheet.dryRunResult_other: With these settings {{n}} alerts would have opened in the last 24 hours
sheet.dryRunTruncated: Only the first 20 keys are shown.
sheet.dryRunStale: The settings changed after the trial; try again for a current result.
